columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice number, kept as text (identifiers are text; Session D rule). A leading C marks a cancellation invoice; see is_cancellation.
columns.rationale: Carried from the committed contract by code (E3b).

columns.name: is_cancellation
columns.description: True when invoice_id carries the C cancellation prefix. Decision: cancellations are retained and flagged, not dropped, so conservation arithmetic against bronze stays auditable; exclusion is a consumer decision made at the mapping contract, not silently here.
columns.rationale: Carried from the committed contract by code (E3b).

columns.name: stock_code
columns.description: Product code as landed, kept as text; alphanumeric suffixes and non-product adjustment codes (for example POST, M) occur.
columns.rationale: Carried from the committed contract by code (E3b).

columns.name: product_description
columns.description: Product description, whitespace-trimmed. Null rate 0.005041 at profile v0001; nulls retained rather than imputed.
columns.rationale: Carried from the committed contract by code (E3b).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Units on the line, cast from DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER. Negative values occur both on cancellation-invoice lines and on zero-unit-price stock-adjustment lines; consumers must not infer cancellation from negative quantity alone.
columns.rationale: Carried from the committed contract by code (E3b).

columns.name: invoiced_at
columns.description: Invoice timestamp. Decision: strict cast from the VARCHAR landing ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"); an unparseable value fails the build loudly rather than becoming a silent null. On within-invoice clock-drift duplicates the earliest scan tick wins (min).
columns.rationale: Carried from the committed contract by code (E3b).

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Unit price in sterling, cast from DECIMAL(38,9). Observed range 0.00 to 1998.49 at v0001. Decision: zero-price lines (freebies and adjustments) are retained; negative prices are contract-invalid.
columns.rationale: Carried from the committed contract by code (E3b).

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier, cast DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER (integral min, max, and samples, 12346 to 18287 at v0001). Decision: the 0.29778 bronze null rate is retained as null (guest or unregistered checkouts), not dropped and not imputed.
columns.rationale: Carried from the committed contract by code (E3b).

columns.name: country
columns.description: Customer country as landed (24 distinct at v0001).
columns.rationale: Carried from the committed contract by code (E3b).

columns.name: captured_at
columns.description: Capture timestamp carried forward from the bronze landing (_airbyte_extracted_at): the moment the surviving line's earliest capture entered the pipeline. It is the incremental watermark the gold layer builds on. Required: the incremental capture path now populates it on every row, so consumers may rely on it always being present and must treat a missing value as a pipeline defect rather than an expected gap.
columns.rationale: Carried from the committed contract by code (E3b).

Operator intent confirms this and requests the tightening. This is a widening direction (false to true) per rule 7, requiring no relaxation flag.

purpose: The cleaned, typed, one-row-per-invoice-line view of the Online Retail II sample: the first contracted silver table and the sole silver input to the gold unified event star.
usage: Read silver.silver_invoice_lines for line-level retail sales analysis. Cancellation lines are RETAINED and flagged (is_cancellation); consumers aggregating revenue must filter or net them deliberately. Zero-price lines are retained.
limitations: Exact duplicate bronze rows (rate 0.011188 at profile v0001) are treated as capture artifacts and excluded, so identical legitimate re-scans are indistinguishable and also excluded; the residual grain is the distinct line. Rows identical in every business column except invoicedate are the same capture artifact seen across a register clock tick (one pair at v0001, invoice 492807, one minute apart); they collapse to one line and the earliest timestamp is retained. customer_id is null on 29.778% of bronze rows at v0001 (guest or unregistered checkouts); those rows are retained with customer_id null.
